preconditions.description: The size of the array is between 1 and 1000.
Each element in the parent array is either -1 (root) or a valid index within the array bounds.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of integers representing the nodes of the binary tree in level order
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of integers where each integer represents a node in the binary tree, starting from the root and proceeding level by level.
